text_block_list.text:
While strolling leisurely through the 
town—
Waaaah! Game over again~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, we are getting the hang of it. 
Let us regroup and try again.
choice_data_list: What game are you playing?
What game are you playing?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is a co-op gun shooting game, "Buddy 
Hazard."
choice_data_list: What game are you playing?
What game are you playing?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reports indicate that clearing the
highest 
difficulty today rewards a plushie of the 
mascot character, "Kumohaza-kun."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really want Kumohaza-kun! But it's so 
hard~!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us pause for a breath before turning 
the next corner. This time for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah! A pincer attack this time~!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please dodge! That is a feint...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Progression rate is steadily increasing. 
However...
choice_data_list: It's really tough to clear, huh.
It's really tough to clear, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Clearing it requires high concentration. 
Due to repeated trial and error, their 
levels are currently dropping.
choice_data_list: This is pretty tough to clear.
This is pretty tough to clear, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I am only permitted to maintain 
the status of "Observer."
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to play?
Aren't you going to play?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is—
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to try?
Aren't you going to join in?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will execute and accomplish this
mission 
without fail.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Wait, huh!? Aren't both the enemies 
and Bourbon-san moving really weirdly!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Incomprehensible. The moment contact was 
initiated,
the arcade cabinet initiated an 
unexpected action—

text_block_list.name: Arcade Machine
text_block_list.text:
"BEEP-SKRRR-BZZT!!
*Chime* ♪ ——Please call 
an attendant."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Subsequently, repeated attempts produced 
continuous errors. The arcade issued an 
order prohibiting me from further play.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, direct intervention is 
impossible for me.
choice_data_list: Then let's send them strength by c...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cheering...
choice_data_list: Then let's give them strength with...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Cheering...
choice_data_list: Remember your 'Lightning Training'!
You know how reassuring it is to h...
You know how reassuring it is to h...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
'Lightning Training'... Back then, 
Bakushin O-san, Laurel-san,
and the others 
cheered for me.
choice_data_list: Remember your 'Lightning Training'!
You know how reassuring it is to h...
You know how reassuring it is to h...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Their presence granted me courage, 
allowing me to take steps toward 
overcoming lightning.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, cheering provides strength. This 
time, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Please! I believe in your 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-We did itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's all thanks to 
Ikuno's guidance and Bourbon-san's 
cheering!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude as well. When we were about 
to falter,
Bourbon-san's cheering restored 
our vitality.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, there is no need for thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cheering imparts tremendous power upon
the 
recipient— I have re-learned this lesson 
today.

Mihono Bourbon congratulated their
victory 
with a gentle smile. At the same time,
she seemed to be recalling her friends who
had once cheered for her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. I clearly remember how 
reassuring it felt to receive cheers
while 
running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:

me to overcome difficult situations.
